reference_configuration.host_cpu: Intel Xeon E5-2697A v4, single socket
gpus: AMD Radeon AI PRO R9700 at 0000:05:00.0
AMD Radeon AI PRO R9700 at 0000:08:00.0
reference_configuration.kernel: Ubuntu 6.8.0-139 base, local Broadwell 8086:6f00 P2PDMA whitelist patch
reference_configuration.iommu: Intel VT-d Translated (DMA-FQ), as recorded for tested runs; peer IOVA mapping chain is open
reference_configuration.rccl: 2.27.7 source baseline with local PHB override patch for direct-P2P condition

artifacts.test_conditions: Sanitized lspci capture from the single-socket E5-2697A v4 reference host; two R9700 devices installed.
artifacts.summary: Sanitized PCI enumeration: device IDs, BAR resource addresses and sizes.
artifacts.limitations: Resource enumeration does not identify the address used in a GPU peer DMA request.

artifacts.test_conditions: Sanitized PCI sysfs/topology capture from the same reference host and device layout.
artifacts.summary: Sanitized PCI ancestry and Root Port relationships for the reference host.
artifacts.limitations: Applies to the captured host topology only.

artifacts.test_conditions: Cross-process HIP IPC; 1, 16, and 64 MiB tiers; exporter/importer direction tested both ways.
artifacts.summary: Six HIP IPC content-integrity cases recorded across both GPU directions and 1, 16, and 64 MiB sizes.
artifacts.limitations: External test binary/source is not included; output does not trace DMA-BUF, IOMMU, GPUVM, or PCIe request addresses.

artifacts.test_conditions: Reference dual-GPU TransferBench capture; directional SDMA, GFX Push, and GFX Pull measurements.
artifacts.summary: SDMA and GFX Push about 10.29 GB/s per direction; GFX Pull about 3.14 GB/s GPU0 to GPU1.
artifacts.limitations: Reverse-direction GFX Pull result is absent; no bottleneck cause is established.

artifacts.test_conditions: RCCL Rank-2 Ring AllReduce; 1–1024 MiB; NCCL_P2P_LEVEL=PHB; patched RCCL library; test log records direct transport markers.
artifacts.summary: RCCL reports isAllDirectP2p 1 and via P2P/IPC; Rank-2 AllReduce reaches about 9.49 GB/s bus bandwidth.
artifacts.limitations: Bus bandwidth is a collective metric, not a one-direction peer-copy rate. Error-free status is limited to the capture interval.

artifacts.test_conditions: Sanitized kernel journal/error collection associated with the reference test interval.
artifacts.summary: Sanitized kernel health log records zero AER and DMAR faults in the sampled interval.
artifacts.limitations: A bounded observation, not a guarantee for other intervals or workloads.

artifacts.test_conditions: SGLang v0.5.18 TP=2 Qwen3.8-27B-AWQ; stock RCCL/SHM compared with patched RCCL/direct P2P; five runs per prefill tier/mode and three concurrency batches per mode.
artifacts.summary: Stock-RCCL/SHM vs patched-RCCL/direct-P2P SGLang TP=2 raw A/B runs, including 1K, 4K, 16K and 32K prefill plus decode and concurrency.
artifacts.limitations: Five runs per mode and prefill tier; three batches per mode and concurrency tier. RCCL build/configuration and transport change together, so the comparison does not isolate P2P as the sole cause.

missing_stages: DMA-BUF export/import and importer attach for a traced peer buffer
dma_map_resource input and returned IOVA for that resource
IOMMU mapping tied to the imported peer buffer
GPUVM PTE for the peer buffer
GPU-emitted PCIe request address during the captured transfer
address_mapping_chain.private_trace_status: Values were quoted in internal notes; raw eBPF capture, collection procedure, and matching kernel/source provenance are not included. They are not public proof of the end-to-end mapping chain.
